adds.title: Jessica Jones S2#3
adds.text: Foggy hand-delivers the partners' buyout offer to Jeri and offers to help her fight it, but she angrily tells him to stay out of her business and do his job.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Foggy's boss, who scorns his offer of help.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A lawyer at her firm whose help Jeri turns down.
adds.evidence: AKA Sole Survivor (JJ S2 ep 3): Foggy delivers Benowitz and Chao's buyout proposal and wants to help; Jeri tells him off ('A partner? Your goddamn boss?').

adds.title: Jessica Jones S2#3
adds.text: Jeri tells Jessica she has ALS and asks her to dig up leverage on the partners trying to push her out of her firm, and Jessica takes the case.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The investigator Jeri hires to find dirt on her partners.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A lawyer who hires Jessica to find leverage on her partners.
adds.evidence: AKA Sole Survivor: Hogarth is diagnosed with ALS, her partners plan to buy her out, and Jones agrees to investigate them to find blackmail material for her.

adds.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law#2
adds.text: From prison, Blonsky writes Bruce a letter with a haiku, and the two make amends, so Bruce gives his approval when Jen is asked to represent Blonsky.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An old enemy who writes from prison to make amends.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An old foe Blonsky makes amends with by letter.
adds.evidence: Superhuman Law (ep 2): Walters gets Banner's approval before taking Blonsky's parole case; Blonsky had written Banner a letter with a haiku and the two made amends.

adds.title: Iron Fist S2#5
adds.text: Colleen and Misty team up to track down Mary Walker and find the wounded Danny, then overpower Walker together.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who helps Colleen find Danny and take down Walker.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend Misty teams up with to find Danny.
adds.evidence: Heart of the Dragon (IF S2 ep 5): Wing and Knight track Walker, find Rand, then overpower Walker and take her and Joy back to the dojo.

adds.title: I Am Groot#5
adds.text: Groot swipes Drax's soap for a portrait of the Guardians, leaving Drax hunting for it.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who swipes Drax's soap for his art.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate whose soap Groot swipes for a portrait.
adds.evidence: Magnum Opus (I Am Groot S1 ep 5, the fifth short overall): Groot gathers Drax's soap for his Guardians portrait; Drax (non-speaking) goes to shower, finds the soap missing and searches for it.

adds.title: Agent Carter S2#10
adds.text: Jack joins Howard and Peggy's team at Howard's studio, and when Howard blasts the Zero Matter out of Whitney Frost with the gamma cannon, Jack takes her into custody.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An SSR chief who helps Howard's team stop Whitney Frost.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An inventor whose gamma cannon helps Jack bring in Frost.
adds.evidence: Hollywood Ending (AC S2 ep 10): Thompson helps the team building the rift machine; at Stark's filming facility Stark shoots Frost with the gamma cannon and Thompson apprehends her.

adds.title: Agent Carter S2#3
adds.text: Peggy enlists Howard's help to investigate the Arena Club, and while studying an anomaly around her he discovers that Jason Wilkes is alive but invisible.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A close friend who brings Howard in on her case.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend who helps Peggy investigate the Arena Club.
adds.evidence: Better Angels (AC S2 ep 3): Carter enlists Howard Stark to investigate the Arena Club; investigating a gravitational anomaly around Carter, Stark discovers Wilkes is alive but invisible.

adds.title: Hawkeye#5
adds.text: Yelena and fellow freed Widow Sonya, who are helping deprogrammed Widows, reunite with another former Widow, Ana.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Fellow Widows Yelena helps after their deprogramming.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A freed Widow who helps the others after deprogramming.
adds.evidence: Ronin (Hawkeye ep 5): in 2018, Yelena and fellow Black Widow Sonya, who have been helping deprogrammed Black Widows, reunite with another former Widow, Ana.

adds.title: Jessica Jones S3#1
adds.text: Vido drops by to hear about Jessica's latest heroics and invites her to dinner, which she turns down.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A neighbor kid who loves hearing about her heroics.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A neighbor whose heroics Vido loves hearing about.
adds.evidence: A.K.A. The Perfect Burger (JJ S3 ep 1): Vido visits Jones to ask about her recent heroics (flying to Mexico), then asks her to come to dinner, but she can't.

adds.title: Secret Invasion#2
adds.text: In 1997, Soren is the first Skrull to take Fury's pledge to spy for him in exchange for refuge on Earth, and Fury thanks her for her courage.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Talos' wife, the first to take Fury's pledge.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The spymaster whose pledge Soren is first to take.
adds.evidence: Promises (SI ep 2): in a 1997 flashback Fury offers the Skrulls shelter in exchange for serving as his spy network; Soren steps forward first in human form and Fury thanks her for her bravery.

owner_calls.title: WandaVision
owner_calls.question: In ep 9 Agatha frees all of Westview's residents, Sharon among them, from Wanda's control so they will turn on Wanda. Does that count as Agatha acting on Sharon, enough for a WandaVision#9 stage?
options: No stage (proposed: a group act, no exchange between them)
Add ally, WandaVision#9: Agatha frees Sharon and the other residents from Wanda's control, and Sharon begs Wanda to let them go.
owner_calls.evidence: The Series Finale: Agatha frees the town's residents from Wanda's control, and they convince her to open the barrier.

owner_calls.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
owner_calls.question: The proposed She-Hulk#2 stage has Blonsky making amends with Bruce by letter. Should the kind move from enemy to rival, or stay enemy (they also brawl in ep 9 before the story is rewritten)?
owner_calls.evidence: Superhuman Law: Blonsky wrote Banner a letter with a haiku and the two made amends; The Series Finale: Hulk and Abomination fight at the Intelligencia lodge before K.E.V.I.N.'s rewrite.
